_comment: What finishes a free-text quest objective. Ankama's catalogue does not say.
5,670 of the game's 15,547 objectives are type 0: the client calls them '#1' and gives them
a sentence, 'Examiner la stele d'un vestige dans les paturages'. No map, no element, no
item. Ankama's server decided that and it never left it. Nor does the client say it:
in the 401 captures there are 16 idw frames -the client saying an objective is
done- and all 16 are from the tutorial.
So this is the link, and it is content. Each row says: this objective is closed by clicking
this element on this map. It is checked with tools/check_quest_bindings.py, which requires
the objective to exist, to be of the kind that does not close by itself, to belong to the quest
the row names, and the element to really be on the map it says.
'elements' is a LIST because the objectives talk about 'un vestige', not 'le vestige':
where there are several in the same subarea any of them will do, and tying only one would send whoever
clicked the other one across the subarea without knowing why.
skill 114 is 'Utiliser', the client's generic one. type -1 is what the captures declare
for these elements: graphic 3518 shows up 32 times and carries -1 all 32.

bindings.why: «Entrer dans la salle des métiers». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.

«Haz salir a la rata de su escondite». The same element as 9895, the cellar's only prop; the order is imposed by the lemonade, which this one asks for and that one does not. The Limonada de Incarnam is item 8543 and texts 534963 and 534964 tell the scene: tooth marks on the tap, and the glass set on top of the barrel. The Rata Nsiosa (4113) is in ZERO groups of the world because this is its place. The rat that comes out is an NPC, the Rata Nsiosa (2912), not a group: the capture has its jsn right after ieb 9769, and «Atacar a la rata.» starts the fight on 153486338.

«Inspecciona el sotano». The cellar has two elements and the other one, 488963, is the STAIRS: the teleports dump declares it as a passage to 153357316, so tying it here would have closed the objective on going up. 489505 is the only real prop, and its drawing (701195) does not appear on any other map of the game.

«Entra en el antro de Minilubo Albino»: the lair is 152836096, «Snoowolf's Tomb», reached through the rusty grate west of the graves (Klasmor's 20841, the line the objective names; Dofus pour les noobs: «cliquez sur la grille du tombeau pour entrer») or past Chadalid. The catalogue gives the objective the graves' map, 153881600, where the gravedigger stands: entering it would have done it on the way to him.

«Examiner la stele d'un vestige sur la route des ames». Element 504680 is the only one with graphic 3518 in subarea 450, which world.db calls «Route des ames». Map [2,-3]. The tavern's, 504679 on [0,-3] (Pandawa's), counts as well: Dofus pour les noobs gives it as the one «à la taverne et donc sur la route des âmes».

«Examiner la stele d'un vestige dans les champs». The two elements with graphic 3518 on map [0,-4], whose subarea is 444 «Champs» -which MapLoadHandler renumbers to 20663, and that is why world.db leaves it nameless-. Either will do.
«Examiner la stele d'un vestige pres du lac». The four with graphic 3518 in subarea 442, which world.db calls «Lac». Maps [0,-2], [0,-1], [-1,-2] and [-2,-2].
«Examiner la stele d'un vestige dans les paturages». The two with graphic 3518 in subarea 445, «Paturages». Maps [1,-4] and [2,-4].
«Examiner la stele d'un vestige dans la foret». The only one with graphic 3518 in subarea 443, «Foret». Map [2,-2].
«Entrer dans la Tour du Conseil d'Astrub». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Entrer dans la taverne d'Astrub». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Aller au rendez-vous fixé par Badufron». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Entrer dans la mine d'Astrub avec le chienchien fidèle». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Entrer dans le repaire du maître des Srams». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
Busca el origen de los problemas. It is Didier Jean, at the pond: the guide puts him as the second step and objective 13955 already places him on map 188744194.
Charla con los mercenarios. The Mercenaire agace is NPC 4405, and his only three replies belong to this quest.
Busca a Camilo Demolinos. It is NPC 4407, Camille Demouleur, whom objective 13961 names next. No map because the catalogue gives him none.
Vence a los canallas. The guide says two Iops and a Cra: the Canalla yopuka is monster 5250 and the Canalla ocra 5249. It is tied to the yopuka because it is the one that repeats.
«Retourner avec Finney sur la tombe où vous avez trouvé l'indice». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Rejoindre Becky devant le caveau». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Se rendre à la cabane de Becky». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.
«Retourner au caveau». It closes on stepping onto the map, and the map is not guessed: the objective itself carries it.

«Mover tu personaje a la casilla resaltada». The client highlights the cell; the server closes it on the first walk finished on the tutorial's start map (the capture's jrw and jqi, then idz 3226 with no idw).
«Plataforma del puch celestial». The capture closes it on arriving at Ganymed's platform (jru 241438721, idz 3228) and starts 2502 «Empezar bien» right there (ief 2502), with no NPC in between.

«Habla con Ganymed para comenzar una nueva misión». In the capture talking to him after the first fight closes it (idz 3169), puts the six items of his «He metido algunos objetos en tu bolsa» in the bag (iua 10784, 10785, 10794, 10799, 10800, 10801); 2511 «Primeras armas» starts on his reply (ief 2511), see content/npcs/dialogues.json.
«Cercado de jalatós celestiales». The capture closes it (ieb 2511 19538) on arriving at the jalatós' pen.

«Gana el combate contra los dos monstruos celestiales». The tutorial capture validates it (idz 3172) as the fight against the celestial jalatín and jalató ends, right after 2511's own ieb 19249 and ied; the jalatín (8017) leads that group.
«Recolecta trigo». The tutorial capture closes it (ieb 1629 9657) on the wheat of the jobs room, element 541424, which gives 289.
«Recoge ortigas». Element 541426 gives 421, then ieb 1629 9658.
«Tala fresnos». Element 541425 gives 303, then ieb 1629 9659.
«Extrae hierro». Element 541427 gives 312, then ieb 1629 9660.
«Pesca un gobio». Element 541428 gives 1782, then ieb 1629 9661.
«Recolecta los recursos necesarios para la fabricación del anillo». The capture validates it (idz 2502 3187) right after the fifth resource's ieb.
«Enseña el anillo al maestro Curro antes de seguir tu camino». Talking to Curro once the ring is made validates it (idz 2502 3189) in the capture, with 1629's ied.
«Entra en la sala de combate». The tutorial capture closes it (ieb 1630 9680) on arriving at Master Darmas's room, jru 241441793.
«Habla con el maestro Darmas y vuelve a ver a Ganymed». The tutorial capture closes 2502 (ied) right after the jru to the Dofusarium that Ganymed's «Seguir a Ganymed» makes.
«Averigua más información sobre tu objetivo: los dofus»: the six statues of the Dofusarium, each read (Dofus pour les noobs: «consultez les statues de chacun des Dofus»).
«Averigua más cosas sobre tu destino»: the Celestial Temple's book on the next room (Dofus pour les noobs: «direction la map sur la droite. Inspectez le Livre du Temple Céleste»).
«Lee el libro de la leyenda de Rykke Errel»: the book in the library's bottom corner (readables.json).

«Habla con un veterano»: Noken Okuto, the old adventurer at the village gate, and his story of the six dofus; done when he wishes the character luck (24909 «Reconozco que tus palabras son bastante sabias», which leads to his 20793). After Fécaline has sent the character to the three seekers.

«Habla con una felina casera»: Azar, the Ecaflip of the tavern, who reads the character's future in her dice (Dofus pour les noobs: «Elle vous propose alors de jeter les dés à votre tour»); done on any throw.

«Habla con un ladrón desafortunado»: Oscar Kasa, the ghost of the phoenix rock, is chased off by an evil fire and the fire turns on the character (Dofus pour les noobs: «la bête s'en prend à vous»; «Lorsque vous avez vaincu la bête et parlé aux trois quêteurs de Dofus, retournez auprès de Fécaline»). Done on beating it.
«Vence a Minilubo Albino»: monster 4102, in his lair, where the NPC Minilubo (2911) starts the fight (npc_fights.json).

«Utiliza el portal para ir a Astrub en el Mundo de los Doce»: the portal is an actor (4398) and crossing it is its reply that leads to Astrub (36977 in PortailIncarnam.pcapng, 36980 for whoever has seen Master Anemó). After talking to him, as the step lists it.
«Examina el zaap del prado»: the last reply of Xelora's talk on where the zaaps come from, «Examinar el zaap justo al lado.» (25016).

«Utiliza el catalejo de Masvisto»: his telescope at the island's north edge, element 489417 (graphic 42502, the only one of its kind on the map, drawn by tools/dibujar_mapa.py), on cell 234. After talking to him.
«Utiliza el catalejo de Galilea»: her telescope over the void, element 489418 (graphic 32525) on cell 369. After talking to her.

«Tumba de Percy Klópeo», a «discover the map» whose map is only text: the tomb is 153356288, entered from [4,1] (Dofus pour les noobs: «Le Tombeau de Percy Klop se trouve en [4,1]. Entrez dans le tombeau»).
«Registra la tumba»: the tomb in the middle of the vault, element 489506 (graphic 49357) on cell 343, the only element of the map that is not the way out. Percy Klópeo comes out of it (showsNpc).
«Sigue las huellas en dirección a la entrada de la cloaca, en la pradera»: the trail ends on the meadow where the apple thieves are, the map 14170 and 14171 name ([7,-10] per Dofus pour les noobs).

«Registra la carreta»: the thieves' cart, element 516185 (graphic 13112, the only one of its kind on the map) on cell 423; it holds the apples saved (19751). Dofus pour les noobs: «Une fois le combat gagné, cliquez sur la charrette pour récupérer les marchandises».
«Entrénate»: «cliquez sur le gros tronc en bois au centre de la pièce» (Dofus pour les noobs), element 516184 (graphic 32053) on cell 330, the middle of the instructress's room.
